trigger: A dry-run of the frozen select_frozen_cohort(seed=100100) sampling algorithm against the current PASS pool (not touching the real algorithm or any real files - a standalone reproduction, purely to test feasibility before building the real HistoricalEvent registry) showed that meeting the pool-wide financing_reserve aggregate (>=20) does not guarantee the specific 120-event cohort the fixed seed actually selects will itself satisfy validate_cohort()'s >=20 financing requirement: the deterministic seed's stratum/year shuffle only captured 18 of the 20 needed among the 120 it selected, with 102 of those 120 selected candidates still financing_status=PENDING (never individually checked either way). This ledger targets exactly those 102 selected-but-unverified candidates, via a bulk SEC EDGAR submissions-API sweep for 424B2/3/4/5 filings inside each candidate's own T-90/T+30 window, followed by manual content verification of each hit to confirm genuine, already-consummated dilution (not a theoretical ATM/shelf capacity) per the qualification_rule already established in financing-evidence-ledger-03.json and -04.json.
qualification_rule: Count only actual issuer equity or equity-linked dilution occurring from T-90 through T+30. Theoretical shelf or ATM capacity without actual issuance is not sufficient. The bulk sweep surfaced 29 candidate offering-form hits across 18 distinct candidates; several were ATM-establishment prospectus supplements with no confirmable in-window actual-sales figure (rejected, matching the AXSM-2019-05-09/ATAI-2022-11-10/TERN-2023-05-15 precedent from financing-evidence-ledger-04.json) and one (EC-2023-IMTX-IMA203) was a resale-registration 424B3 whose underlying private-placement issuance date (2023-07-21) actually falls outside the T-90 window despite the registration filing date falling inside it (rejected on that basis). Six candidates cleared the bar with a firm underwritten public offering ('We are offering N shares...') confirmed directly in the prospectus supplement text, several evidenced by the classic preliminary-then-final 424B5 filing pair two calendar days apart.

promotion_boundary: These six rows restore financing-reserve margin specifically within the actual seed=100100 selected cohort (verified by the same standalone dry-run simulation used to discover the gap), not just the pool-wide aggregate. Final financing quota remains provisional until timestamp/conference, point-in-time evidence, concentration, eligible-registry and deterministic cohort-freeze requirements are satisfied. Several other bulk-sweep hits (AXSM 2019-05-09, ATAI 2022-11-10, GWPH 2017-12-05/08, ANNX, TRIL, ARRY, NVAX, REGN, IMTX) remain unverified or were explicitly rejected and are candidates for a future batch if more margin is wanted.
